notes: Sync now sends changes in batches of up to 200.
The activity page shows which device a change came from.
Fixed a crash when a calendar was deleted while it was syncing.
Fixed guests being asked to sign in twice.
Faster first load of the week view.
Fixed the timeout being applied to the whole call instead of each try.
Retries are now logged with their delay.
New: shared availability across calendars.
A Retry-After delay is now capped by maxDelayMs.
Dropped support for the v1 sync endpoints.
Retries now honour the Retry-After header.
Fixed the week view starting on Sunday for some locales.
New: templates for standups, offsites and on-call rotas.
Retries now use full jitter instead of a fixed delay.
Fixed duplicate events after moving a recurring event.
Fixed invitations going out in the wrong time zone.
Smaller downloads on slow connections.
Fixed a sync loop when two devices renamed the same calendar.
The default timeout is now 30 seconds.
Fixed history older than 90 days showing on the Solo plan.
New: guests can answer straight from the invitation email.
Calls to the sync service are now retried up to five times.
Fixed all-day events ending a day early.
New: the activity page.
Exports now include declined events.
New sync service (v2): changes arrive in seconds, not minutes.
New: the Studio plan.
Calendars from v1 are moved over the first time you sign in.
